audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows contradicted the prose beside them. Level 1 read Ziggs while whys[0] says it is even; Levels 2, 3 and 4-5 were given to Skill and Vladimir while whys[1], whys[2] and whys[3] all say Ziggs sieges you off the wave; Level 6 read Ziggs while whys[4] says it evens out as Pool and Hemoplague let you gap-close.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Skill, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir — exactly the whys.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Skill (5/10), rows 1-3 to Ziggs (4/10), row 4 to Skill (5/10), as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: His levels 2-5 siege window, your level 6 gap-close, the Rylai's first-item flip and your two-item short-range duel are all placed correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet records that no Ziggs ability is named in the content layer and that no line carries a cooldown. The do's and don'ts bodies were copies of the trading blurb, and nothing said Short Fuse is an auto reset that comes back faster every time he casts, or that Hexplosive Minefield's repeat detonations do less.
audit.why: Kit file: P Short Fuse, auto reset whose cooldown drops on every ability cast; Q Bouncing Bomb 850 range / 6-4s; W Satchel Charge 1000 range / 20-12s, knocks both of you away; E Hexplosive Minefield 900 range / flat 16s, slows, successive detonations reduced; R Mega Inferno Bomb 5000 range / 120-70s. Vladimir Q and E reach 600, Pool is 2s untargetable.
audit.corrected: Satchel's 20s and its double knock-away, the 850-vs-600 range gap, the minefield's flat 16s, and the Short Fuse reset written into the do's and don'ts.

audit.why: The packet's suspectName flag on wants.you[1] ('Use Transfusion') is a false positive — Transfusion is the real name of Vladimir's Q and the line is correct as written.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Satchel Charge knocks you away and is his escape, 20s at rank 1 — walk him down there.

edits.before: Transfusion Ziggs on cooldown, E-charge behind the wave, and pool the one ability his kill plan needs.
edits.after: Bouncing Bomb reaches 850 on a 6s cooldown and Transfusion only 600 — step in after the bomb lands.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Pool the Satchel blast: 2s untargetable beats the knock-away.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.

notes: Both layers agreed with each other but disagreed with the packet chart and with their own whys on five of seven rows; realigned to the packet. The packet's suspectName on wants.you[1] is a false positive — Transfusion is correct. I did not assert that Satchel Charge deals percent-max-health damage: the kit carries that derived flag but Riot's description says only magic damage plus knock-away, so the description wins. No mirror existed yet.
